Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 27
, Reason for Mistake: In the “New plan” the Orchestrator dropped the requirement to verify that each hike was recommended by at least three different people with kids and focused mainly on pulling hikes from a single family blog and checking TripAdvisor ratings. This planning error led to compiling a final list without multi-source parent recommendations and to including Wraith Falls even after WebSurfer showed it had only ~4/5 from ~44 reviews (below 4.5 and <50), so the final answer failed the user’s constraints.
